design_reason: Part I Gaara must retain a jinchuriki-era combat identity distinct from Kazekage Gaara; M50 must replace/tune with the final researched signature Rage Skill.
ANBU Itachi must not reuse the complete Akatsuki Mangekyo-heavy kit; generic ocular genjutsu is kept as a conservative pre-final identity marker.
Part I Kabuto emphasizes medical-nin competence and must not share the complete later-form kit.
Young Kakashi uses his Chidori-era identity and must not execute Kamui.
ANBU Kakashi is separated from War Kakashi by a Lightning Blade climax instead of Kamui.
Rinnegan Madara must expose Rinnegan identity distinct from the EMS version.
Edo Minato is differentiated through his later Kurama chakra access; final trigger/timing belongs to M50.
Hokage Naruto must not reuse the exact Six Paths five-slot kit; this preserves adult Kurama combat identity pending final Rage Skill research.
Young Obito must not inherit the complete masked Kamui/Rinnegan-era kit.
White Mask Obito carries explicit Rinnegan-era identity distinct from masked and young versions.
Genin Lee needs a distinct early speed-taijutsu slot; M50 must replace this conservative proxy with a researched exact named technique if appropriate.
Genin Sakura must not inherit the complete Shippuden medical/strength kit; this conservative early-combat proxy is explicitly pending M50 research.
Genin Sasuke must not inherit Hebi's later signature climax; Chidori preserves the Part I identity while M50 finalizes Rage Skill design.
